title: Draft: MySQL: cut some trees

notes.body: I think I would prefer for the Packet Diagrams to recurse into FT_NONE fields, which are generally containers. That would work in general. I can give it a go.

I'll mark this as draft for now.

It *might* be good to do both as these kinds of packets use a subtree for most of the packet which isn't consistent with the rest of this (and other?) dissector(s).

I assume you've seen wireshark/wireshark#20943 ?
Yes, I do. I'll mark it when I work on this.
